grid.help: Size of the map. The tiles and the legend stay raw JSON for now (a map painter comes later): see the tree view.

fog.help: Fog of war on this map (docs/ECONOMY.md).

fogVision.help: Sight added to every unit under fog (needs fog).

aiSeesAll.help: Computer sides see everything under fog (needs fog).

structures.help: Structures placed on the map (contents of chests: tree view).

side.help: Id of the side that owns it (leave out for none).

id.help: Id events name it by (letters, digits, _ and -).

uses.help: Shots left of a map weapon.

contents.help: What a chest holds (at least one entry).

uses.help: Uses left (at most the item's own).

visitSides.help: Sides that may visit it (places with a visit block).

visitUnits.help: Units or characters that may visit it.

sides.help: The sides of the battle (at least two).

team.help: Sides of one team do not fight each other.

aiSeesAll.help: A computer side sees everything (true) or is bound by fog (false).

difficultyShift.help: The difficulty setting changes this side.

faction.help: Faction of the side; "choose" lets the person pick (needs factions.json).

commander.help: Commander of the side; "choose" lets the person pick (needs commanders.json).

id.help: Id of the unit (events and story name it).

side.help: Id of one of the map's sides.

name.help: Display name (a character's own by default).

level.help: Level of the unit (at most the game's maximum).

items.help: Items it carries (replaces its type's or character's).

stats.help: Exact stats instead of the type's (a stat written here is never shifted by difficulty).

facing.help: Direction the unit looks (needs rules.facing); the names depend on the grid, e.g. north, east.
